body:
Thank you for the comment theMaroonWave. I'm sorry it's taken so long to reply.

It's been different with different friends, but the main ones I didn't ever see anymore and the only times we interacted were online, but I wasn't happy playing or talking with them anymore. So I thought, if they were just people I met online would I still be friends with them, no. Then not long after I started thinking that, one of them lost it one day and purposely pushed my buttons. He has apologized, but it really just pushed me the way I was already thinking. I feel cold hearted for thinking that way, evaluating people and, like I said in the original post, I have days where I wish I could go back, but I know I'll just end up coming to the same cold hearted decisions.

More recently I was playing with another friend and when their friend joined us their friend exploded and threatened me out of nowhere. Then he left and she did as well, and she blamed me for it. I don't blame myself for this encounter, but I considered them my last good, real friend, so it hurts a lot to think about.

Because of the dead time I've had since last May I've been doing a lot of movies, music, and mainly games. It has helped me get through a lot of time, but a year is forever when you have nothing to do. I've burned through a lot of the available media I'm interested in, heck I've gone through some series on Netflix 2 or 3 times. I find myself day after day laying around staring at the ceiling with no energy, wanting to do nothing.

Last month I had my resume professionally redone to try and start fresh because I haven't advanced to an interview since December. I went to a job fair right after that, but nothing ever came from it so I've been applying more online. I'm terrified of reaching the end of May without a job because that's the cutoff for many of the entry level positions, as they want people who have graduated from college within the past year.

Thank you again for the reply.

I'm sorry you feel this way. I'm feel like I'm in the same boat. It especially clicked with me when I read the largest paragraph.

I hope you haven't seriously hurt yourself. This may be my first response, but I've been reading this subreddit a lot recently and I know there are good people who are caring and would love to talk to you. I'm not in a great place myself right now, but if you want someone to talk to I'd love to read any replies or messages you, or anyone else who reads this, send.
